subject: Kokoro-82M speech synthesis: AetherSpeech + AetherSpeechCoreAI (0.0.2 checkpoint)

source.license: Apache-2.0 (model card front matter, card text and Hub tag license:apache-2.0, checked 2026-10-26)
source.training_data_attribution: Model card lists CC BY 3.0 (Koniwa tnc) and CC BY 4.0 (SIWIS) audio in the training set

phonemization_decision.decision: Phoneme-string input validated against the bundle vocabulary; G2P is supplied by the app through SpeechPhonemizer. No G2P code, misaki or espeak-ng in any SDK target or in the export/reference harness.
phonemization_decision.reason: misaki (Apache-2.0) falls back to espeak-ng (GPL-3.0) via phonemizer-fork/espeakng-loader for out-of-vocabulary words; GPL is incompatible with the Apache-2.0 SDK.
phonemization_decision.misaki_lexicons: us/gb gold and silver dictionaries ship in the Apache-2.0 wheel without documented provenance; not recommended for bundling until provenance is checked
recommended_routes: CMUdict (BSD) mapped to Kokoro symbols with a permissive or self-trained OOV model

references.implementation: unmodified upstream KModel, CPU float32, SineGen harmonic noise from the shared SplitMix64/Box-Muller seed; repeat runs bit-identical
references.floors: per case: 1e-6 relative harmonic-source perturbation (sensitivity) and upstream float32 vs float64 (precision)

tolerances.waveform_rel_l2: <= 0.05 and <= 4 x the case's upstream float32-vs-float64 rel L2
tolerances.log_mel_mean_abs: <= 0.03 nats (80 HTK mel bands 0-12 kHz, n_fft 1024, hop 256, ln with 1e-5 floor)
tolerances.metric_cross_check: Swift and Python metrics agree on each sensitivity pair (rel L2 within 1e-6 relative, log-mel within 1e-4 relative)

lifecycle.cancellation: CancellationError after durations predicted; state ready; recovery bit-identical to baseline
lifecycle.active_unload: unload waited; active request completed bit-identical; state closed; later request sessionClosed

native.timing_scope: shared host, no quiet-window protocol; warm RTF = repeated synthesis wall time / audio seconds; observations, not benchmarks

cpu_only_native.note: earlier source revision with expectFrequentReshapes for both graphs and uniform cpuOnly placement; rel L2 0.010-0.040, warm RTF 1.25-1.34

gpu_findings: durations graph with preferGPU aborts in MPSGraph ANERegionFormationPass ('Region input 1 was not rank-4 or rank-5'); reproduced with Forge/kokoro/probe_coreai_graph.py
decoder opened with expectFrequentReshapes:true on the GPU aborts in CoreAIRuntime ('Cannot make a Tensor.Layout from an unresolved TensorRequirements'); log: kokoro-gpu-reshape-abort-2026-10-26.log
without the hint each new GPU frame count specializes once (~1.8 s here, cached across processes); MPSGraph logs a non-fatal ANE compile failure and falls back
